purpose: Independent benchmark of a published anomaly, not a tuned extension of the project's own ideas.
hypothesis: Stocks trading closest to their own 252-session high subsequently outperform peers because investors anchor and underreact to information near prior highs.
known_limitations: Five surviving large-cap stocks are too few to reproduce the published broad-universe long-short portfolio.
This is a long-only feasibility benchmark and cannot establish the original anomaly by itself.
Dividends are omitted and must be incorporated point-in-time before promotion.

rules.score: close at month-end divided by maximum close over the preceding 252 sessions including signal day
rules.rebalance: monthly at next NYSE session open
rules.capital: percentage returns only; no dollar capital or leverage

gates.benchmark: Must improve either Sharpe or maximum drawdown versus equal-weight buy-and-hold in both validation and OOS.

prohibitions: No execution, capital or leverage conclusion.
No promotion without a broader point-in-time universe including delisted stocks.
